questions.question: Write a two-sentence summary of: walk 14, taxi 11, bus 6, car 7, bicycle 2 out of 40.
questions.expected_answer: Walking was the most common way to get to school, with 14 of the 40 learners, 35%. Taxis came next with 11 learners, while only 2 learners cycled.

questions.question: Name three possible sources of bias or error in a school survey.
questions.expected_answer: Any three of: an unrepresentative sample, leading questions, a sample that is too small, recording errors, unusual timing such as a rainy day.

questions.question: Pocket money R20, R25, R25, R30, R200: which statistic should the report use for a typical value?
questions.expected_answer: The median, R25, mentioning the R200 outlier, because the mean of R60 is pulled up by that one value.
